query: INSERT INTO tool_usage_daily (day, org_id, project_id, server_id, calls, errors) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::date[], $2::uuid[], $3::uuid[], $4::uuid[], $5::bigint[], $6::bigint[]) ON CONFLICT (project_id, day, server_id) DO UPDATE SET calls = tool_usage_daily.calls + EXCLUDED.calls, errors = tool_usage_daily.errors + EXCLUDED.errors
